zh.title: 聯合航空與勞斯萊斯爭端 45架A350面臨變數
zh.summary: 聯合航空因引擎耐用度與金額爭端；45架A350受影響；波音787重塑機隊
body: 根據Simple Flying報導，聯合航空（United Airlines）與發動機製造商勞斯萊斯（Rolls-Royce）發生爭端，導致45架空中巴士（Airbus）A350客機的引進規劃面臨不確定性。相關爭議焦點涉及發動機耐用度問題以及高達1.75億美元的金額分歧。
與此同時，聯合航空正透過大規模的波音（Boeing）787客機訂單重塑其機隊結構。隨著與勞斯萊斯的發動機耐用度及1.75億美元款項爭執持續，該公司針對45架空中巴士A350客機的後續機隊部署亦受到業界關注。

en.title: United Airlines Rolls-Royce Dispute Puts 45 Airbus A350 Jets At Risk
en.summary: United Airlines disputes Rolls-Royce over engine durability; 45 Airbus A350s at risk; Boeing 787s reshape fleet
body: According to Simple Flying, a dispute between United Airlines and engine manufacturer Rolls-Royce has put 45 Airbus A350 aircraft at risk. The disagreement centers on engine durability concerns as well as a 175 million dollar financial dispute, creating uncertainty over the carrier's future widebody order.

At the same time, United Airlines is actively reshaping its long-haul fleet through a major order for Boeing 787 aircraft. The ongoing dispute with Rolls-Royce regarding engine durability and the 175 million dollar figure continues to impact the decision-making process surrounding the 45 Airbus A350 jetliners.

sources.name: Simple Flying — Why United Airlines' CEO Put Rolls-Royce In The 'Doghouse'…
